user.title: Manual Vault
user.description: Store PDF manuals in Home Assistant and link them to your devices by model. Manuals are kept in the `manual_vault` folder of your configuration and included in backups. After setup, open **Manual Vault** in the sidebar.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Manual Vault is already set up.

init.title: Hidden devices
init.description: Hidden devices don't appear in the Manual Vault device list and don't count as missing a manual. Devices that already have a manual keep their Manual sensor. You can also hide things with the eye icon in the panel.

data_description.integrations: For example phones (Mobile App) and system sensors (System Monitor).
data_description.models: Hides every device of the model, including ones added later.

error.backup_running: A backup is running. Try again in a moment.
